GAMES
stutterscope

Open native CapFrameX JSON or capture CSVs, select a recording, and inspect frame-time gaps and slow-frame source evidence in your browser.

RECORDED EVIDENCE
Filtered Intel gold data: 175 retained frames have 83 clock gaps and only 91 observed pacing pairs; missing durations stay unknown.
